description: The donut chart illustrates the distribution of task types in the context of generative AI’s use in journalism, as presented in the paper “Developing Story Case Studies of Generative AI's Use in Journalism.” It features two categories: “Article generation,” which dominates the chart at 83.2% and is represented by a dark reddish-brown segment, and “Headline generation,” accounting for 16.8% and shown in a muted olive-green segment. The chart’s center displays the label “Task Type,” and each segment is clearly labeled with its corresponding task and percentage. The visual emphasizes the overwhelming prevalence of article generation over headline generation in the studied use cases, with no additional categories or breakdowns included. The chart uses a simple, clean design with no legend, relying instead on direct labeling for clarity.
